one_line: An infinite visual research board for people and AI agents to collect, inspect, and organize heterogeneous source material.
what_it_does: Users place notes, links, images, documents, media, drawings, and other artifacts on an infinite board; the claimed WebMCP surface exposes board state, selection, visual captures, and structured actions to an agent.
leverage_rationale: The claimed integration exposes meaningful shared board concepts—selection, cards, links, drawings, layouts, and PNG views—rather than only UI clicks, making focused human-agent collaboration more reliable and precise than coordinate-driven automation.
leverage_evidence: About text describes WebMCP access to board and current selection, selected drawings as cropped images, structured card text and metadata, and permitted actions.
About text claims browser-computed non-overlapping placement and agent-readable whole-board PNG rasterization.
Frame-sheet evidence shows a visual board with heterogeneous cards and a chat/agent workspace, though no readable tool trace.
execution_rationale: The packet presents a coherent product concept with a substantial visual board and multiple artifact types; the supplied frames show populated workspace states, but the central end-to-end WebMCP workflow is claimed rather than directly demonstrated in a readable video transcript or tool log.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show an empty drag-and-drop state and populated dark-themed board states containing multiple visual/document cards.
Devpost packaging identifies the project and describes the infinite-board workflow.
About text lists selection-aware context, document canvases, layouts, PNG capture, and stylus support.
impact_rationale: Researchers, writers, students, and knowledge workers have a clear need to capture heterogeneous material without premature filing; a shared visual workspace with agent-assisted organization credibly addresses that need.
impact_evidence: Pitch explicitly targets dumping raw notes, links, photos, sketches, and half-thoughts without folders or markdown.
About text describes visual research-board use and support for documents, media, drawings, PDFs, and spreadsheets.
Frames visibly show a populated board containing varied source artifacts.
creativity_rationale: The combination of an infinite visual research board, explicit human selection as context, structured agent operations, and multimodal document-canvas inspection is a fresh and ambitious interaction model.
creativity_evidence: About text frames human selection as an attention signal and combines structured card data with cropped drawing images.
About text claims deterministic browser-side geometry while the agent expresses arrangement intent.
Devpost pitch presents the no-structure-first workflow as the defining concept.
usability_note: The drag-and-drop canvas and selection model appear approachable, but the breadth of artifact types and agent workflow is not fully demonstrated end-to-end in the supplied evidence.
red_flags: The packet says video=False and provides no transcript, while frame sheets show only UI states and no readable tool invocation trace.
The about text is truncated in the supplied packet, limiting verification of the complete claimed surface.
standouts: Strong shared human-agent state model centered on explicit selection.
Thoughtful separation of semantic agent intent from deterministic browser geometry.
Multimodal pairing of structured content with board/document images.
advance_reason: The concept and claimed WebMCP leverage are unusually well aligned, and the frame sheets show a coherent product surface; advance for stronger end-to-end verification despite limited direct agent-invocation evidence.
